name: Vrishabha
personality: Reliable, practical, patient, determined, comfort-loving, and dependable.
relationships: Loyal, affectionate, dependable, and seeks long-term stability in relationships.
health: Throat, neck, thyroid, vocal cords, tonsils.
description: Vrishabha is the second sign of the zodiac, representing stability, wealth, beauty, and endurance. Ruled by Venus, it signifies patience, material comforts, artistic appreciation, and unwavering determination.
